Deq Leet text and seeded patterns of Deq motifs (ADR 0015).
Pure ESM, no DOM, no I/O.

```ts
import { leet, decodeLeet, pattern } from "@0xdolan/deq-generator";
const { svg } = leet("Deq", { level: "basic" });
decodeLeet(svg).text; // "DEQ"
pattern({ kind: "band", seed: 42 }).svg;
```

Source: [`packages/generator`](../../packages/generator/). Install with `npm install @0xdolan/deq-generator`.

## Functions

### `decodeLeet`

```ts
function decodeLeet(svg: string, options?: SceneOptions): DecodedLeet
```

Read the text back from Leet SVG written by `leet` at the `basic` level. Each
glyph group is matched against the table's basic glyphs rendered with `options`, which
must be the render options used to write it (default options by default). The SVG is
treated as text and only matched against what `leet` writes.

**@throws** {DeqError} `INVALID_OPTIONS` when the input is not Deq Leet SVG, or
`LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (input over `MAX_DECODE_INPUT`, more than `MAX_GLYPHS` glyphs).

### `detectScript`

```ts
function detectScript(text: string): Script
```

Pick the script of `text`: Sorani when it has Arabic-script letters, else Latin.

### `entryOf`

```ts
function entryOf(script: Script, char: string): LeetEntry | undefined
```

The entry for an already normalised character, if the table has one.

### `expandGlyph`

```ts
function expandGlyph(glyph: Glyph): readonly Flat[]
```

The flat geometry of a glyph in its own 24 x 24 cell.

### `glyphMarkup`

```ts
function glyphMarkup(glyph: Glyph, o: ResolvedOptions): string
```

The inner markup of a glyph's group, as written by `sceneSvg`.

### `glyphShape`

```ts
function glyphShape(glyph: Glyph): ShapeData
```

The shape description of a glyph: one `use` primitive per part.

### `leet`

```ts
function leet(text: string, options?: LeetOptions): LeetResult
```

Write `text` with Deq glyphs. The input is plain text: it is length-capped, normalised
(NFC, upper case, aliases) and never parsed as markup. Characters without a glyph are
left out and listed in `unknown`; Sorani lines run right to left.

```ts
leet("Deq", { level: "advanced", seed: 42 }).svg;
```

**@throws** {DeqError} `INVALID_OPTIONS` (also when nothing is left to draw) or
`LIMIT_EXCEEDED`.

### `leetTable`

```ts
function leetTable(script: Script): LeetTable
```

The table of `script`.

### `normalize`

```ts
function normalize(input: string, script: Script): Normalized
```

Normalise `input` for `script`: NFC, line breaks to `\n`, joiners and tatweel removed,
upper case, then the table's aliases. Input is plain text and is never parsed as markup.

**@throws** {DeqError} `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` for input longer than `MAX_INPUT`, more than
`MAX_GLYPHS` glyphs or more than `MAX_LINES` lines.

### `pattern`

```ts
function pattern(options?: PatternOptions): PatternResult
```

Generate a pattern of Deq motifs. `band` repeats motifs in a row (alternating or
mirrored), `grid` lays a checkerboard, `rosette` rings petals round a centre and
`border` frames a rectangle with corner and edge motifs.

```ts
pattern({ kind: "rosette", seed: 7, petals: 12 }).svg;
```

**@throws** {DeqError} `INVALID_OPTIONS`, `UNKNOWN_SHAPE` or `LIMIT_EXCEEDED`.

### `prepareScene`

```ts
function prepareScene(scene: Scene, options?: SceneOptions, title?: string): Prepared
```

Prepare `scene` for exporters: the geometry of every cell moved into place, one layer
`cN` per cell and `colors` as layer colours, on a `width` x `height` canvas. With no
colours the layers stay ungrouped, like a single shape; `sceneSvg` is the SVG
writer, this is for the other formats.

**@throws** {DeqError} like `sceneSvg`.

### `resolveSceneOptions`

```ts
function resolveSceneOptions(options?: SceneOptions): ResolvedSceneOptions
```

Validate scene options.

**@throws** {DeqError} `INVALID_OPTIONS`.

### `sceneSvg`

```ts
function sceneSvg(scene: Scene, options?: SceneOptions, title?: string, rootAttrs?: string): string
```

Write `scene` as SVG. Each cell is a `<g data-layer="cN" transform="translate(x y)">`
in cell order, so exporters keep one layer per glyph.

**@throws** {DeqError} `INVALID_OPTIONS`, `UNKNOWN_SHAPE`, `INVALID_PARAMETER` or
`LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (more than `MAX_SCENE_ITEMS` elements).

## Classes

### `Random`

```ts
class Random
```

A deterministic stream of unsigned 32-bit integers.

- `#state: number`
- `next: () => number`: The next unsigned 32-bit integer.
- `below: (n: number) => number`: An integer in `0 .. n - 1` (`n` ≥ 1).
- `pick: <T>(list: readonly T[]) => T`: One element of a non-empty list.

## Constants

### `MAX_DECODE_INPUT`

```ts
const MAX_DECODE_INPUT: number
```

Largest SVG `decodeLeet` reads, in UTF-16 code units.

### `MAX_GLYPHS`

```ts
const MAX_GLYPHS: 256
```

The most glyphs one text may draw.

### `MAX_INPUT`

```ts
const MAX_INPUT: 1024
```

The longest input accepted, in UTF-16 code units.

### `MAX_LINES`

```ts
const MAX_LINES: 32
```

The most lines one text may have.

### `MAX_SCENE_ITEMS`

```ts
const MAX_SCENE_ITEMS: 20000
```

The most drawing elements one scene may expand to.

### `MAX_SEED`

```ts
const MAX_SEED: 4294967295
```

Largest seed; seeds are unsigned 32-bit integers.

const packageName: '@0xdolan/deq-generator'

## Interfaces

### `Cell`

```ts
interface Cell
```

One glyph placed in a scene; the glyph's 24 x 24 cell has its top left at (x, y).

- `x: number`
- `y: number`
- `glyph: Glyph`

### `DecodedLeet`

```ts
interface DecodedLeet
```

The result of `decodeLeet`.

- `text: string`: The text; glyphs that are not basic glyphs read as U+FFFD.
- `script: Script`
- `unmatched: number`: How many glyph groups were not basic glyphs of the table.

### `GlyphPart`

```ts
interface GlyphPart
```

One shape placed in a 24 x 24 glyph cell, about the centre [12, 12].

- `shape: string`
- `params?: Readonly<Record<string, ParamValue>>`
- `transform?: { readonly translate?: readonly [number, number]; readonly scale?: number; readonly rotate?: number; }`

### `LeetEntry`

```ts
interface LeetEntry
```

One character of a table with its glyph at each level.

- `char: string`
- `fit: 'good' | 'fair' | 'rough' | 'count'`: How well the basic glyph reads as the character; `count` marks dot-count digits.
- `basic: Glyph`
- `advanced: readonly Glyph[]`: Alternatives for the advanced level; empty means the basic glyph.
- `full: Glyph`

### `LeetResult`

```ts
interface LeetResult
```

The result of `leet`.

- `svg: string`: The SVG document, one `<g data-layer="cN">` per glyph in reading order.
- `text: string`: The normalised text that was drawn.
- `script: Script`
- `level: LeetLevel`
- `unknown: readonly string[]`: Input characters with no glyph, in first-seen order (they are left out).
- `scene: Scene`: The placed glyphs.

### `LeetTable`

```ts
interface LeetTable
```

The mapping table of one script.

- `version: number`
- `script: Script`
- `direction: 'ltr' | 'rtl'`
- `aliases: Readonly<Record<string, string>>`: Characters read as another character of the table (after case folding).
- `glyphs: readonly LeetEntry[]`

### `Normalized`

```ts
interface Normalized
```

The result of `normalize`.

- `lines: readonly (readonly Token[])[]`: Lines of tokens, without leading or trailing spaces or empty lines.
- `text: string`: The normalised text (what decoding `basic` output gives back).
- `unknown: readonly string[]`: Characters with no glyph in the table, in first-seen order.

### `PatternResult`

```ts
interface PatternResult
```

The result of `pattern`.

- `svg: string`: The SVG document, one `<g data-layer="cN">` per motif.
- `motifs: readonly string[]`: The motifs chosen, in the order the pattern uses them.
- `scene: Scene`

### `ResolvedSceneOptions`

```ts
interface ResolvedSceneOptions
```

Validated scene options.

- `render: ResolvedOptions`
- `colors: readonly string[]`

### `Scene`

```ts
interface Scene
```

Glyphs on a `width` x `height` canvas in grid units.

- `width: number`
- `height: number`
- `cells: readonly Cell[]`

## Types

### `Glyph`

```ts
type Glyph = readonly GlyphPart[]
```

A glyph: one or more shapes on the 24 x 24 grid.

### `LeetLevel`

```ts
type LeetLevel = "basic" | "advanced" | "full"
```

How much a text is transformed.

### `LeetOptions`

```ts
type LeetOptions = SceneOptions & { /** Default `basic`: one readable glyph per character, which {@link decodeLeet} reads back. */ readonly level?: LeetLevel; /** Default: Sorani when the text has Arabic-script letters, else Latin. */ readonly script?: Script; /** Seed for the alternatives of the `advanced` level (unsigned 32-bit). Default 1. */ readonly seed?: number; /** Space between glyphs in grid units (0..24). Default 2. */ readonly letterSpacing?: number; /** Space between lines in grid units (0..48). Default 6. */ readonly lineSpacing?: number; /** Line alignment; `start` is the left for Latin and the right for Sorani. Default `start`. */ readonly align?: "start" | "center" | "end"; }
```

Options of `leet`; the render options apply to the whole text.

### `PatternKind`

```ts
type PatternKind = "band" | "grid" | "rosette" | "border"
```

The kinds of pattern.

### `PatternOptions`

```ts
type PatternOptions = SceneOptions & { /** Default `band`. */ readonly kind?: PatternKind; /** Seed (unsigned 32-bit). The same seed and options give the same pattern. Default 1. */ readonly seed?: number; /** Shapes to choose motifs from (1..64 catalog ids). Default: every catalog shape. */ readonly motifs?: readonly string[]; /** Band: number of cells, odd, 3..63. Default 9. */ readonly count?: number; /** Grid and border: columns, 1..32 (border: 3..32). Default 5 (border: 7). */ readonly cols?: number; /** Grid and border: rows, 1..32 (border: 3..32). Default 5 (border: 3). */ readonly rows?: number; /** Rosette: number of petals, 3..24. Default 8. */ readonly petals?: number; /** Space between cells in grid units (0..24). Default 2. */ readonly spacing?: number; }
```

Options of `pattern`; the render options apply to the whole pattern.

### `SceneOptions`

```ts
type SceneOptions = Omit< RenderOptions, "rotation" | "flipX" | "flipY" | "params" | "layerColors" > & { /** Colours given to the cells in turn (at most 16). Default: every cell uses `color`. */ readonly colors?: readonly string[]; }
```

Options for scene output: the render options of a single shape, except the per-shape
`rotation`, `flipX`, `flipY`, `params` and `layerColors`, plus `colors`.

### `Script`

```ts
type Script = "latin" | "sorani"
```

A script with a Leet table.

### `Token`

```ts
type Token = | { readonly kind: "char"; readonly char: string; readonly entry: LeetEntry } | { readonly kind: "space" }
```

One unit of normalised text: a table character, a space or a line break.
